<p>Prof. He presented high-efficiency zirconia polishing wheel solutions, advancing Sharpen’s role in ceramic phone-component machining. On March 17, 2017, Sharpen was invited to the 2nd Powder Metallurgy / Ceramic Phone-Shell Technology & Application Forum in Shenzhen. Prof. He presented on high-efficiency, high-precision zirconia polishing wheels. Drawing on intermetallic-compound bond theory and more than 3,000 formulation trials, Sharpen developed a mature solution for zirconia ceramic phone back-plates and fingerprint-recognition wafers that greatly improves machining efficiency and lowers cost for customers, advancing the company’s scale application in ceramic phone-component machining.</p>
